run_wait_for_stop: run wait_for_stop to block until a stop signal is received with an optional timeout
create_get_worker_manager: create a worker manager instance by calling get_worker_manager with v1 or v2 backend
test_register_stop_handler: test register_stop_handler to register a callback that fires on worker stop
refactor_unregister_stop_handler: refactor unregister_stop_handler to remove a previously registered stop callback
summarize_stop_event: summarize stop_event to retrieve the stop event object from the active worker manager
